experiment: 018-real-anchor (E9, Amendment 18 of docs/04-phase4-plan.md; exploratory under D-016)

choice.rule: higher mean (over the 20 anchor draws) macro AUROC; if the two means differ by < tie_auroc, the lower mean FPR (reading A, full model) wins; frozen in results/choice.json before any RAISE/OI adapted result is computed

methods.E7: unadapted E7 probe, threshold = 1% FPR of the training sources' calib reals (reference, no anchors)
methods.A-thr: unadapted E7 probe, threshold = 1% FPR of the anchor reals' own scores (simplest baseline)
methods.A-off: shift the held-out source's REAL (test) features by (mean of training reals - mean of anchor reals), T-aug mean in raw feature space, then score with the unchanged E7 probe; threshold from the training calib reals (PRE-REGISTERED, literal reading: only the held-out source's features move, fakes do not)
methods.A-off-all: sensitivity: the same shift applied to the held-out source's reals AND to all test fakes (what a deployed per-pipeline correction does when labels are unknown): AUROC unchanged, only the operating point moves
methods.A-off-pc: sensitivity: A-off with the offset estimated per evaluation condition (anchors and training reals processed identically) instead of one T-aug mean offset
methods.A-proj: project the unit vector of (mean of training reals - mean of anchor reals), in the standardized space of the training reals, out of ALL features (train and eval), retrain the probe on the projected training data (same recipe and CV as E7), threshold from the training calib reals

offset_definition: mean over the three T-aug conditions (clean, jpeg75_resize05, social_sim) of the per-condition mean; training reals = train-role reals of the training sources (VISION: natives), anchors = train/calib-role reals of the held-out source (VISION: natives)
anchor_pool: held-out source's train+calib-role reals in its train_pools (VISION natives 99+43, RAISE 84+53, OI 300+100); group-disjoint from its test reals (device / caption family / image), checked in selftest
anchor_draws: per (source, draw) one seeded permutation of the pool; n anchors = first n (nested over n); same rows for both arms

fpr_readings.A: threshold = 1% FPR on clean scores of the reference reals (training calib reals, or the anchors for A-thr), applied at every condition (headline, E6/E7 convention)
fpr_readings.B: threshold from the same-condition scores of the reference reals (sensitivity)

gain_vs_athr: FPR(A-thr operating point) - FPR(method) at the method threshold whose macro TPR (equal weight per generator, 'full' model) reaches A-thr's macro TPR; mean over the 20 draws; CI = 2.5/97.5 percentile of the draw-mean over the 1,000 cluster-bootstrap replicates of E7's plan

criteria.no_gain: 0 of 3 sources with gain CI lower bound > 0

label_rule: PASS: every held-out source AUROC >= 0.90 and FPR <= 3% AND gain over A-thr (CI lower bound > 0) on >= 2 of 3 sources. KILL: any source AUROC < 0.85 or FPR > 8%, OR no gain over A-thr. Else INCONCLUSIVE. All at fov512, jpeg75_resize05, F_b8, n = 50, method chosen on the VISION fold only.
fpr_model: full model (7 train generators), as E7 reading A; drop-one-generator subsets use the LOGO model that never saw the dropped generator

owner.status: pending: confirmatory 4th held-out pipeline, all choices frozen
